description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's packed-refs functionality, specifically avoiding unnecessary rewriting and marking of packed-refs files in various scenarios.

methods.name: mark_packed_refs
methods.description: Adds a 't1409' marker to the header line of the packed-refs file without rewriting the entire file.

methods.name: check_packed_refs_marked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file contains the 't1409' marker indicating it has been marked.
